theorems.name: Submission.bf_sphereGood_densityDichotomy
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (σ : Measure (Rn N)), IsFiniteMeasure σ → ∀ (S : Set (Rn N)) (c₁ C₁ : ℝ), 0 < c₁ → (∀ ζ ∈ S, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 2 → ENNReal.ofReal (c₁ * ρ ^ n) ≤ σ (Metric.ball ζ ρ)) → (∀ ζ ∈ S, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → σ (Metric.ball ζ ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₁ * ρ ^ n)) → ∀ (m : OuterMeasure (Rn N)) (F : Set (Rn N)), MeasurableSet F → F ⊆ S → m F = 0 → σ {θ | θ ∈ F ∧ ¬ (∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < η → m (S ∩ Metric.ball θ t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * t ^ n)) ∧ ¬ (∀ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t < η ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (K * t ^ n) < m (S ∩ Metric.ball θ t))} = 0
